| a539a463 | I2 per-child extraction (first pass) plus addendum-1 second pass (same agent resumed) | sonnet, high x60 | 60 | 168,392 | 423,911 (372,983 first pass + 50,928 addendum pass) | 790,783 | 15,093,073 |
| a9214043 | D5b other-report extraction, tranche 1 (11 included reports) | sonnet, high x91 | 91 | 131,077 | 341,721 | 338,734 | 16,144,290 |
Estimate stated before the D5b launch: 25,000 to 35,000 total tokens per report; actual 31,065 per included report (341,721 / 11); output per included report 11,916. The estimate ignored the 84-PMID inclusion step (about a third of the run: 52 exclusions with reasons, 20 closed papers, 1 blocked) which is a fixed cost, so the cost per report extracted overstates the marginal cost of one more report. Sum of the two deepening-round delegates: output 299,469; total 765,632.
| a7d5728b | tonic-current full-text dossiers, 12 papers (5 fully read, 7 abstract-only: 6 blocked by Cloudflare/AWS-WAF challenge pages, 1 closed) | sonnet, high x36 | 36 | 69,417 | 222,988 | 220,175 | 3,869,632 |
Tonic dossiers: estimate before launch 25,000-35,000 total tokens per paper (300-420k for 12); actual 222,988 total (18,582 per paper; 44,598 per fully read paper), 10.7 minutes. The seven abstract-only papers include the three mouse layer 2/3 papers (Drasbek 2006, 2007; Vardya 2008) and Yamada 2007 and Keros 2005, all behind challenge pages from the publisher sites (not solved or bypassed); they remain a human-access item. Sum of the three deepening-round delegates: output 368,886; total 988,620.
